​The Technology: Even as a layman, I could tell his equipment was state-of-the-art. It was clearly superior to the apparatus used at the other clinics I visited that day, and it made the process significantly more comfortable.
​Patient Comfort: Though the clinic is compact, the patient chair was the most comfortable one I’ve sat in (out of 3 that day). When you are in pain, these details truly matter.
​Dr. Dilesh’s calm demeanor, patience, and modern approach brought me relief that I thought was impossible after being sent away by so many others. If you are looking for an ENT who combines high-level expertise with genuine empathy, look no further.

featured_reviews.review_text:
When everything around us felt uncertain and overwhelming, Dr. Anjoo
Choudhary became the first ray of hope in our journey. At a time when our newborn was struggling, answers were unclear, and fear had taken over, her very first consultation brought us clarity, direction, and reassurance.

Dr. Choudhary was the one who suspected Tracheo-Esophageal Fistula (TEF) and promptly guided us through the exact tests needed to confirm the diagnosis. That early suspicion and decisive action changed the entire course of our son’s treatment. Looking back, we know how crucial that moment was.

Her explanations were thorough, clear, and incredibly reassuring. She took the time to help us understand what was happening, what to expect, and what the next steps would be — never rushing us, never dismissing our fears. Her expertise as an airway surgeon is truly at par with the best, but what sets her apart is her deep empathy and emotional support.

Beyond medical guidance, Dr. Choudhary helped us navigate one of the most emotionally fragile phases of our lives as parents. She listened, she comforted, and she stood by us — not just as a doctor, but as a pillar of strength when everything felt like it was falling apart.

We will always be grateful to Dr. Anjoo Choudhary for giving us hope when we needed it the most, for her clinical excellence, and for her compassion that made an unbearable journey feel manageable.
